sources.title: NaiveAI/Naive-N0.5-Flash · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Naive-N0.5-Flash is an open-weight 309B MoE model with 15.5B active parameters, built for coding and AI R&D. It supports a native 1M-token context window through a hybrid of Sliding-Window Attention (SWA) and lightweight DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA), with no full-attention layers.

sources.snippet: Introduction Naive-N0.5-Flash is an open-weight 309B MoE model with 15.5B active parameters, built for coding and AI R&D. It supports a native 1M-token context window through a hybrid of Sliding-Window Attention (SWA) and lightweight DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA), with no full-attention layers.

sources.snippet: Naive-N0.5-Flash is a 309-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model (15.5B active parameters per token) from NaiveAI, a Beijing startup founded by Tsinghua associate professor Dai Jifeng.
